# SQ-1600: a verified command sequence for Lost Pig (LostPig.z8, Eric Eve,
# Release 2 / Serial 080406, Inform v6.30 6/11), reconstructed by booting the
# real game headlessly and driving it turn by turn, checking every reply
# against the actual interpreter, and confirming the final score against the
# game's own SCORE/FULL command output. This is NOT a copy of any published
# walkthrough's prose -- it is this project's own derived list of literal game
# commands, produced for automated regression testing
# (crates/app/tests/suites/walkthrough_lostpig.rs).
#
# A web search surfaced only vague, partly-inaccurate prose summaries of the
# solution (no IF-Archive .sol file for this title was found); those were used
# only as a rough guide to WHICH puzzle areas exist (a pole, a coin-op box, a
# gnome, a missing book page) -- every individual command below was derived and
# checked against the real interpreter's actual replies, and several of the
# guide's specific claims (e.g. a literal "coin" on the stairs, dousing lit
# powder with water) turned out to be wrong once checked.
#
# Format: one command per line; blank lines and `#`-comment lines are
# ignored. A line submitted while the game is at a single-keypress (Char)
# prompt is sent as a keypress (its first character); otherwise it is
# submitted as an ordinary typed line.
#
# This game carries its own maximum score of 7, confirmed via the in-game
# SCORE/FULL commands. The walkthrough below reaches all 7 points and the
# game's best ending, "*** Grunk bring pig back to farm and make new friend
# ***" -- one point ("earn gnome respect") is earned only by returning BOTH
# the key and the color-magnet pole to the store room (Shelf Room) AND
# closing the secret door behind you in the Windy Cave before leaving through
# the maze; skipping either half of that leaves the score at 6/7 with the
# plainer ending "*** Grunk bring pig back to farm ***".
#
# The walkthroughs.rs-style harness (walkthrough_lostpig.rs) injects its
# mid-script persistence checks (an in-game @save/@restore round trip and a
# host Save State/Restore State round trip) right after the `give paper to
# gnome` below (back in the Gnome Room, mid-conversation, at a Line prompt)
# -- see that file's `CHECKPOINT_AFTER_COMMAND` for exactly where and why.
